value: This document serves as the README for `markdown-it-abbr`, a plugin designed to extend the `markdown-it` parser by enabling the generation of HTML `<abbr>` (abbreviation) tags. It allows users to define abbreviations using a specific Markdown syntax (e.g., `*[TERM]: Definition`), which the plugin then converts into corresponding HTML `<abbr>` elements with a `title` attribute. The document details its usage, including installation via npm/bower and integration with `markdown-it` instances, noting compatibility requirements (v1+ requires markdown-it v4+). The plugin is released under the MIT license.
